steps.note: Open an existing published RFQ with vendor quotes so all three actions can be exercised.
Open the event actions menu.
Enable the mode under test.
Reopen the actions menu to verify the mode is enabled.
Confirm the menu now offers disabling View-Only Mode.
Open the comparison grid containing the existing vendor quote.
Verify a counter offer is refused while View-Only Mode is enabled.
Open the published RFQ participants list for the surrogate-bid check.
Verify a surrogate bid is refused while View-Only Mode is enabled.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal to test quote editing.
Open the RFQ pricing round with the vendor's existing quote.
Verify the vendor cannot revise its quote while View-Only Mode is enabled.
Return to the buyer console to disable the mode.
Open the actions menu.
Disable View-Only Mode.
Reopen the actions menu to verify the mode is disabled.
Confirm the menu now offers enabling View-Only Mode again.
Return to the vendor portal to retry quote editing.
Reopen the RFQ pricing round.
Verify the vendor can revise its quote after View-Only Mode is disabled.
Confirm the revised vendor quote was submitted.
Return to the buyer console for the remaining retries.
Open the participants list for the surrogate-bid retry.
Verify a surrogate bid is available after View-Only Mode is disabled.
Confirm the surrogate bid was accepted.
Return to the comparison grid for the counter-offer retry.
Verify a counter offer is available after View-Only Mode is disabled.
Confirm the counter offer was sent.
